title: China Drinking Culture Map
synopsis: Let’s explore the many nuances of Chinese drinking culture and experience the enthusiasm for drinking and the unique customs of people from different regions.

fullText.simplified:
中国酒文化地图

    说起中国酒文化，很多人第一个想到的是白酒。其实，不是每个中国人都喜欢喝白酒，不同地方的人喜欢不同的酒，也有不同的喝酒习惯。
    中国人喝什么酒？白酒是中国的国酒，大部分地方的中国人都会喝白酒。但是近几年，人们的选择越来越多了。年纪大的人习惯喝白酒，年轻人主要喝啤酒，有时候也会喝白酒和红酒。北方人主要喝白酒和啤酒，南方人除了这两种，还会喝米酒。米酒的度数不高，喝起来有点甜。北方的内蒙人喜欢喝奶酒，奶酒也是甜的，但是度数比米酒高。
    哪儿的人爱喝酒？其实这是一个很难回答的问题。总的来说，北方人比较爱喝酒。北方人喝酒的时候很热情，希望朋友喝得高兴。所以北方人会一边喝酒一边大声说话，有时候会唱歌跳舞。“再喝一杯”、“干杯”是大家喝酒时常说的话。
    中国人什么时候喝酒？关于什么时候喝酒，主要有节日、结婚、朋友和工作这四种情况。节日的时候，中国人喜欢和家人一起喝两杯，这也是中国人喝酒最热情的时候。结婚跟节日一样，是一件让人高兴的事情，但人们会注意，少喝两杯。在别人结婚的时候喝醉，是一件不太好的事情。朋友见面，一边吃肉一边喝酒玩游戏，是非常不错的选择。为了工作，有时候也要喝酒，但这几年，这样的情况越来越少了。
    总之，中国有很多不同的酒文化，不同地方的人也有不同的喝酒习惯。当然，这些不同不是一定的。现在大家的文化交流越来越多，各个地方酒文化的差别也越来越小了。
fullText.traditional:
中國酒文化地圖

    說起中國酒文化，很多人第一個想到的是白酒。其實，不是每個中國人都喜歡喝白酒，不同地方的人喜歡不同的酒，也有不同的喝酒習慣。
    中國人喝什麼酒？白酒是中國的國酒，大部分地方的中國人都會喝白酒。但是近幾年，人們的選擇越來越多了。年紀大的人習慣喝白酒，年輕人主要喝啤酒，有時候也會喝白酒和紅酒。北方人主要喝白酒和啤酒，南方人除了這兩種，還會喝米酒。米酒的度數不高，喝起來有點甜。北方的內蒙人喜歡喝奶酒，奶酒也是甜的，但是度數比米酒高。
    哪兒的人愛喝酒？其實這是一個很難回答的問題。總的來說，北方人比較愛喝酒。北方人喝酒的時候很熱情，希望朋友喝得高興。所以北方人會一邊喝酒一邊大聲說話，有時候會唱歌跳舞。“再喝一杯”、“乾杯”是大家喝酒時常說的話。
    中國人什麼時候喝酒？關於什麼時候喝酒，主要有節日、結婚、朋友和工作這四種情況。節日的時候，中國人喜歡和家人一起喝兩杯，這也是中國人喝酒最熱情的時候。結婚跟節日一樣，是一件讓人高興的事情，但人們會注意，少喝兩杯。在別人結婚的時候喝醉，是一件不太好的事情。朋友見面，一邊吃肉一邊喝酒玩遊戲，是非常不錯的選擇。為了工作，有時候也要喝酒，但這幾年，這樣的情況越來越少了。
    總之，中國有很多不同的酒文化，不同地方的人也有不同的喝酒習慣。當然，這些不同不是一定的。現在大家的文化交流越來越多，各個地方酒文化的差別也越來越小了。

sentences.simplified: 说起中国酒文化，很多人第一个想到的是白酒。
sentences.traditional: 說起中國酒文化，很多人第一個想到的是白酒。

sentences.simplified: 其实，不是每个中国人都喜欢喝白酒，
sentences.traditional: 其實，不是每個中國人都喜歡喝白酒，
sentences.pinyin: qí shí bú shì měi ge zhōng guó rén dōu xǐ huan hē bái jiǔ
sentences.english: Speaking of Chinese drinking culture, the first thing that comes to mind for many people is baijiu.

sentences.simplified: 不同地方的人喜欢不同的酒，也有不同的喝酒习惯。
sentences.traditional: 不同地方的人喜歡不同的酒，也有不同的喝酒習慣。
sentences.pinyin: bù tóng dì fang de rén xǐ huan bù tóng de jiǔ yě yǒu bù tóng de hē jiǔ xí guàn
sentences.english: In reality, not every Chinese person likes baijiu.
People from different places like different types of liquor and also have different drinking habits.

sentences.simplified: 中国人喝什么酒？
sentences.traditional: 中國人喝什麼酒？
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó rén hē shén me jiǔ

sentences.simplified: 白酒是中国的国酒，大部分地方的中国人都会喝白酒。
sentences.traditional: 白酒是中國的國酒，大部分地方的中國人都會喝白酒。
sentences.pinyin: bái jiǔ shì zhōng guó de guó jiǔ dà bù fen dì fang de zhōng guó rén dōu huì hē bái jiǔ
sentences.english: What liquor do Chinese people like to drink?

sentences.simplified: 但是近几年，人们的选择越来越多了。
sentences.traditional: 但是近幾年，人們的選擇越來越多了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì jìn jǐ nián rén men de xuǎn zé yuè lái yuè duō le
sentences.english: Baijiu is China’s national drink. Chinese people from most places will drink baijiu.

sentences.simplified: 年纪大的人习惯喝白酒，年轻人主要喝啤酒，有时候也会喝白酒和红酒。
sentences.traditional: 年紀大的人習慣喝白酒，年輕人主要喝啤酒，有時候也會喝白酒和紅酒。
sentences.pinyin: nián jì dà de rén xí guàn hē bái jiǔ nián qīng rén zhǔ yào hē pí jiǔ yǒu shí hou yě huì hē bái jiǔ hé hóng jiǔ
sentences.english: However, in recent years, people have had more and more choices.

sentences.simplified: 北方人主要喝白酒和啤酒，南方人除了这两种，还会喝米酒。
sentences.traditional: 北方人主要喝白酒和啤酒，南方人除了這兩種，還會喝米酒。
sentences.pinyin: běi fāng rén zhǔ yào hē bái jiǔ hé pí jiǔ nán fāng rén chú le zhè liǎng zhǒng hái huì hē mǐ jiǔ
sentences.english: Older people are used to drinking baijiu. Younger people mostly drink beer and will also sometimes drink baijiu and red wine.

sentences.simplified: 米酒的度数不高，喝起来有点甜。
sentences.traditional: 米酒的度數不高，喝起來有點甜。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ jiǔ de dù shu bù gāo hē qǐ lái yǒu diǎn tián
sentences.english: Northerners mostly drink baijiu and beer, while southerners will also drink rice wine in addition to these two.

sentences.simplified: 北方的内蒙人喜欢喝奶酒，
sentences.traditional: 北方的內蒙人喜歡喝奶酒，
sentences.pinyin: běi fāng de nèi měng rén xǐ huan hē nǎi jiǔ
sentences.english: Rice wine doesn’t have a high alcohol content and tastes a bit sweet

sentences.simplified: 奶酒也是甜的，但是度数比米酒高。
sentences.traditional: 奶酒也是甜的，但是度數比米酒高。
sentences.pinyin: nǎi jiǔ yě shì tián de dàn shì dù shu bǐ mǐ jiǔ gāo
sentences.english: People from Inner Mongolia in the north like to drink arkhi, a liquor made using milk.
Arkhi is also sweet but has a higher alcohol content than rice wine.

sentences.simplified: 哪儿的人爱喝酒？其实这是一个很难回答的问题。
sentences.traditional: 哪兒的人愛喝酒？其實這是一個很難回答的問題。
sentences.pinyin: nǎ'r de rén ài hē jiǔ qí shí zhè shì yí ge hěn nán huí dá de wèn tí

sentences.simplified: 总的来说，北方人比较爱喝酒。
sentences.traditional: 總的來說，北方人比較愛喝酒。
sentences.pinyin: zǒng de lái shuō běi fāng rén bǐ jiào ài hē jiǔ
sentences.english: In which areas do people love drinking? This is actually a very difficult question to answer.

sentences.simplified: 北方人喝酒的时候很热情，希望朋友喝得高兴。
sentences.traditional: 北方人喝酒的時候很熱情，希望朋友喝得高興。
sentences.pinyin: běi fāng rén hē jiǔ de shí hou hěn rè qíng xī wàng péng you hē de gāo xìng
sentences.english: Overall, northerners tend to like drinking more.

sentences.simplified: 所以北方人会一边喝酒一边大声说话，有时候会唱歌跳舞。
sentences.traditional: 所以北方人會一邊喝酒一邊大聲說話，有時候會唱歌跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ běi fāng rén huì yì biān hē jiǔ yì biān dà shēng shuō huà yǒu shí hou huì chàng gē tiào wǔ
sentences.english: When northerners drink, they are very enthusiastic, wanting their friends to have a good time drinking.

sentences.simplified: “再喝一杯”、“干杯”是大家喝酒时常说的话。
sentences.traditional: “再喝一杯”、“乾杯”是大家喝酒時常說的話。
sentences.pinyin: zài hē yì bēi gān bēi shì dà jiā hē jiǔ shí cháng shuō de huà
sentences.english: So, northerners will talk loudly while drinking and will sometimes sing and dance.
“One more drink” and “cheers” are words that are often said while drinking.

sentences.simplified: 中国人什么时候喝酒？
sentences.traditional: 中國人什麼時候喝酒？
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó rén shén me shí hou hē jiǔ

sentences.simplified: 关于什么时候喝酒，主要有节日、结婚、朋友和工作这四种情况。
sentences.traditional: 關於什麼時候喝酒，主要有節日、結婚、朋友和工作這四種情況。
sentences.pinyin: guān yú shén me shí hou hē jiǔ zhǔ yào yǒu jié rì jié hūn péng you hé gōng zuò zhè sì zhǒng qíng kuàng
sentences.english: When do Chinese people like drinking?

sentences.simplified: 节日的时候，中国人喜欢和家人一起喝两杯，
sentences.traditional: 節日的時候，中國人喜歡和家人一起喝兩杯，
sentences.pinyin: jié rì de shí hou zhōng guó rén xǐ huan hé jiā rén yì qǐ hē liǎng bēi
sentences.english: Regarding when people drink, there are four main situations: holidays, weddings, friends, and work.

sentences.simplified: 这也是中国人喝酒最热情的时候。
sentences.traditional: 這也是中國人喝酒最熱情的時候。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yě shì zhōng guó rén hē jiǔ zuì rè qíng de shí hou
sentences.english: During holidays, Chinese people like to have a few drinks with family.

sentences.simplified: 结婚跟节日一样，是一件让人高兴的事情，但人们会注意，少喝两杯。
sentences.traditional: 結婚跟節日一樣，是一件讓人高興的事情，但人們會注意，少喝兩杯。
sentences.pinyin: jié hūn gēn jié rì yí yàng shì yí jiàn ràng rén gāo xìng de shì qing dàn rén men huì zhù yì shǎo hē liǎng bēi
sentences.english: These are also the times when Chinese people are most enthusiastic about drinking.

sentences.simplified: 在别人结婚的时候喝醉，是一件不太好的事情。
sentences.traditional: 在別人結婚的時候喝醉，是一件不太好的事情。
sentences.pinyin: zài bié ren jié hūn de shí hou hē zuì shì yí jiàn bú tài hǎo de shì qing
sentences.english: Weddings, like holidays, bring joy to people. However, people will be cautious and drink a bit less.

sentences.simplified: 朋友见面，一边吃肉一边喝酒玩游戏，是非常不错的选择。
sentences.traditional: 朋友見面，一邊吃肉一邊喝酒玩遊戲，是非常不錯的選擇。
sentences.pinyin: péng you jiàn miàn yì biān chī ròu yì biān hē jiǔ wán yóu xì shì fēi cháng bú cuò de xuǎn zé
sentences.english: Getting drunk at someone else’s wedding isn’t a good thing.

sentences.simplified: 为了工作，有时候也要喝酒，但这几年，这样的情况越来越少了。
sentences.traditional: 為了工作，有時候也要喝酒，但這幾年，這樣的情況越來越少了。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le gōng zuò yǒu shí hou yě yào hē jiǔ dàn zhè jǐ nián zhè yàng de qíng kuàng yuè lái yuè shǎo le
sentences.english: When meeting friends, drinking and playing games while eating meat is a very good option.
Drinking is also sometimes needed for work, but such situations have become less and less common in recent years.

sentences.simplified: 总之，中国有很多不同的酒文化，
sentences.traditional: 總之，中國有很多不同的酒文化，
sentences.pinyin: zǒng zhī zhōng guó yǒu hěn duō bù tóng de jiǔ wén huà

sentences.simplified: 不同地方的人也有不同的喝酒习惯。当然，这些不同不是一定的。
sentences.traditional: 不同地方的人也有不同的喝酒習慣。當然，這些不同不是一定的。
sentences.pinyin: bù tóng dì fang de rén yě yǒu bù tóng de hē jiǔ xí guàn dāng rán zhè xiē bù tóng bú shì yí dìng de
sentences.english: In conclusion, there are many different drinking cultures in China.

sentences.simplified: 现在大家的文化交流越来越多，
sentences.traditional: 現在大家的文化交流越來越多，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài dà jiā de wén huà jiāo liú yuè lái yuè duō
sentences.english: People from different places also have different drinking habits. Of course, these differences are not absolute.

sentences.simplified: 各个地方酒文化的差别也越来越小了。
sentences.traditional: 各個地方酒文化的差別也越來越小了。
sentences.pinyin: gè gè dì fang jiǔ wén huà de chā bié yě yuè lái yuè xiǎo le
sentences.english: Nowadays, as cultural exchanges are increasing, ..

sentence_translations: China Drinking Culture Map
Speaking of Chinese drinking culture, the first thing that comes to mind for many people is baijiu.
In reality, not every Chinese person likes baijiu.
People from different places like different types of liquor and also have different drinking habits.
What liquor do Chinese people like to drink?
Baijiu is China’s national drink. Chinese people from most places will drink baijiu.
However, in recent years, people have had more and more choices.
Older people are used to drinking baijiu. Younger people mostly drink beer and will also sometimes drink baijiu and red wine.
Northerners mostly drink baijiu and beer, while southerners will also drink rice wine in addition to these two.
Rice wine doesn’t have a high alcohol content and tastes a bit sweet
People from Inner Mongolia in the north like to drink arkhi, a liquor made using milk.
Arkhi is also sweet but has a higher alcohol content than rice wine.
In which areas do people love drinking? This is actually a very difficult question to answer.
Overall, northerners tend to like drinking more.
When northerners drink, they are very enthusiastic, wanting their friends to have a good time drinking.
So, northerners will talk loudly while drinking and will sometimes sing and dance.
“One more drink” and “cheers” are words that are often said while drinking.
When do Chinese people like drinking?
Regarding when people drink, there are four main situations: holidays, weddings, friends, and work.
During holidays, Chinese people like to have a few drinks with family.
These are also the times when Chinese people are most enthusiastic about drinking.
Weddings, like holidays, bring joy to people. However, people will be cautious and drink a bit less.
Getting drunk at someone else’s wedding isn’t a good thing.
When meeting friends, drinking and playing games while eating meat is a very good option.
Drinking is also sometimes needed for work, but such situations have become less and less common in recent years.
In conclusion, there are many different drinking cultures in China.
People from different places also have different drinking habits. Of course, these differences are not absolute.
Nowadays, as cultural exchanges are increasing, ..
.. the differences in alcohol culture between different places are getting smaller and smaller.
